project_overview.full_title: Aegis: Explainable AI-Assisted Document Scrutiny & Regulatory Verification Platform
project_overview.tagline: Dual-Portal AICTE Scrutiny & Statutory Compliance Engine
project_overview.target_regulation: AICTE Approval Process Handbook (APH 2026-27) & AICTE Act 1987
project_overview.core_purpose: Explainable, decision-oriented regulatory scrutiny platform designed to eliminate cognitive fatigue for AICTE scrutiny officers while giving colleges pre-submission compliance audit feedback.
primary_stakeholders: AICTE Central Scrutiny Directorate (Scrutiny Officers & Committees)
project_overview.key_differentiation: Unlike generic cloud portals that act as dumb storage, and unlike black-box generative AI models that hallucinate authenticity, Aegis employs a deterministic, transparent, 24-check validation pipeline with immutable SQLite audit logging, explicit category concordance, and a simplified 1-verdict decision card.
planned_or_incomplete_features: Production Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for handwritten/regional language scanned deeds (e.g. Tesseract / Bhashini API)
Official government database integration (State Bhulekh Land Registries, DigiLocker, National Single Window System - NSWS)
Cryptographic Public Key Infrastructure (PKI / DSC) Digital Signature validation for issued deeds

official_sih_details.problem_statement_title: AI-Powered Application Validation, Document Authentication and Regulatory Compliance Verification
official_sih_details.note: ID SIH26261 is used in project presentations; verify against official SIH portal allocation if an alternate ID is formally issued.

team_details.note: Team registration fields not present in source code; marked NOT PROVIDED per strict verification guidelines.

web_framework.name: Streamlit
web_framework.routing_pattern: Dynamic st.navigation with st.Page session isolation (eliminates multi-page URL bypass vulnerabilities)

document_processing.name: PyMuPDF (fitz)
document_processing.role: Native PDF binary parsing, stream decoding, page-by-page text extraction, font dictionary audit, and revision counting

database.name: SQLite 3
database.role: Relational persistence with foreign keys, ACID transactions, and WAL journal mode

cryptography_and_security.document_hashing: FIPS 180-4 SHA-256 (256-bit cryptographic digest per file)

ocr_framework.name: None
ocr_framework.note: PyMuPDF native text stream extraction is used; no external OCR binary (Tesseract/EasyOCR) is bundled or invoked in aegis-foundation.

ml_framework.name: None in aegis-foundation
ml_framework.note: AICTE-Validator had .joblib models (scikit-learn Logistic Regression and GBDT); aegis-foundation intentionally replaced them with deterministic, explainable rule sets to avoid black-box hallucinations and maintain statutory GovTech compliance.

ocr_and_text_extraction.method: Native PDF stream text extraction using PyMuPDF (fitz) page.get_text('text')
ocr_and_text_extraction.output: extracted_text, page_texts, is_scanned, total_chars, CheckResults (TEXT_EXTRACT_PER_PAGE, TEXT_READABILITY_SCANNED_CHECK)
ocr_and_text_extraction.limitation: Optical character recognition (OCR) on rasterized scanned images is not implemented; scanned pages (<50 chars) are detected and routed to human review without failing.

document_type_classification.method: Deterministic token matching against CATEGORY_CONCORDANCE_RULES dictionaries (concordant and discordant keyword tokens)
document_type_classification.output: CheckResult (DOC_CATEGORY_FILENAME_MATCH) with status PASS, FAIL, or WARNING
document_type_classification.limitation: Evaluates naming and lexical token concordance; does not use an ML neural classifier.

filename_and_category_matching.method: Regex cleaning of base filename, token set extraction, and intersection against category discordant and concordant tokens
filename_and_category_matching.output: CheckResult flagging discordance (FAIL) or concordance (PASS), with explicit disclaimer authenticity_verified=False
filename_and_category_matching.limitation: Filename concordance does not establish legal authenticity; a mismatch indicates probable misfiling, not necessarily fraud.

required_field_and_content_validation.method: Versioned Rule Registry (v2026.1.0) keyword frequency evaluation and regex date extraction (DD/MM/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD)
required_field_and_content_validation.limitation: If document is scanned (0 text), records NOT_RUN to avoid false failure; requires human officer inspection of physical stamp.

cross_document_consistency_checking.method: Cross-referencing SHA-256 hashes, Permanent Institute ID (Code), and Institution Name across companion documents in the same dossier
cross_document_consistency_checking.input: current_sha256, extracted_text, application metadata, companion_docs list
cross_document_consistency_checking.limitation: Text-based name comparison uses token normalization; variations in scanned OCR text require manual review.

pdf_structural_integrity.method: PyMuPDF parsing of PDF header, trailer, catalog, cross-reference table, page tree, encryption flags, and embedded attachments
pdf_structural_integrity.output: CheckResults (PDF_PARSE_INTEGRITY, PDF_PAGE_COUNT, PDF_ENCRYPTION_CHECK, PDF_ATTACHMENT_CHECK, PDF_INCREMENTAL_UPDATES, PDF_ACTIVE_CONTENT_CHECK)
pdf_structural_integrity.limitation: Checks PDF container validity; successful parsing does not prove the document is authentic.

metadata_inspection.method: PyMuPDF doc.metadata inspection for /Producer, /Creator, /CreationDate, /ModDate, and chronological timestamp inversion
metadata_inspection.limitation: Scanning hardware frequently omits metadata or has uncalibrated system clocks, which may cause false timestamp warnings.

duplicate_detection_and_file_hashes.method: Cryptographic hashlib.sha256 digest calculation and collision matching across application documents in SQLite
duplicate_detection_and_file_hashes.limitation: Detects identical binary payloads; a re-saved or re-scanned document has a different hash and is not flagged by hash comparison alone.

document_tampering_and_forensic_heuristi.method: Pattern scanning for online consumer PDF utilities (Canva, Smallpdf, iLovePDF, Sejda), counting %%EOF incremental revision sections, embedded font subset auditing, and scanning for active /JavaScript or /Launch actions
document_tampering_and_forensic_heuristi.input: PDF raw bytes, metadata, font dictionaries
document_tampering_and_forensic_heuristi.limitation: These are advisory heuristic flags. Consumer tools or incremental updates frequently occur in legitimate administrative PDF handling.

llm_or_external_ai_integration.method: None. Aegis does not call OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or local LLMs.
llm_or_external_ai_integration.limitation: Deliberately excluded to eliminate hallucinations, token costs, and privacy leaks in government scrutiny workflows.

automated_finding_summaries.method: Deterministic mapping of check failures to a concise 4-field structure: Expected, Uploaded, Finding, Action
automated_finding_summaries.output: Actionable findings list formatted for human decision-making
automated_finding_summaries.limitation: Limited to the 24 deterministic check types implemented in the engine.

application_verdict_aggregation.method: Conservative hierarchical verdict computation (ACTION_REQUIRED > CHECK_INCOMPLETE > MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED > CLEAR)
application_verdict_aggregation.input: Dossier validation run results and mandatory document checklist status
application_verdict_aggregation.output: Single prominent verdict: CLEAR, ACTION REQUIRED, MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED, or CHECK INCOMPLETE
application_verdict_aggregation.limitation: Operates strictly over completed automated checks; CLEAR does not guarantee authenticity.

stages.name: File Integrity & Security
stages.description: Validates extension allowlist, non-empty byte length, magic byte signatures (%PDF-), 15MB file size boundary, SHA-256 digest, and path traversal guards.

stages.name: PDF Structure & Diagnostics
stages.description: Parses PDF object catalog and trailer via PyMuPDF; audits page count, encryption/password lock, metadata dictionary, embedded attachments, incremental revisions (%%EOF), and active executable scripts (/JavaScript).

stages.name: Text Extraction & Readability
stages.description: Extracts text page-by-page. Digital PDFs with text streams pass; scanned image PDFs (<50 characters) are gracefully flagged as REVIEW_REQUIRED with an explicit notice that land deeds and notarized affidavits are frequently scanned.

stages.name: Forensic Heuristics
stages.description: Scans metadata for online consumer PDF utilities (Canva, Smallpdf), checks for inverted/future modification timestamps, and audits embedded font dictionaries across pages.

stages.name: Document Content & Rule Registry
stages.description: Evaluates document category concordance (e.g. Land Title vs Affiliation Letter) and verifies versioned statutory keywords from Rule Registry (v2026.1.0) along with statutory date plausibility.

stages.name: Cross-Document Consistency
stages.description: Audits SHA-256 payload collisions across application categories, checks Permanent Institute Code consistency, and verifies normalized Institution Name across companion documents.

system_architecture.pattern: Multi-Tenant GovTech Architecture with Role-Based Access Control and Append-Only Audit Logging
system_architecture.data_flow: Institutional Upload (Screen B) -> Binary Security Gate -> Validation Pipeline (24 Checks) -> SQLite Persistence (validation_runs, validation_checks) -> Aggregation Layer (Verdict & 4 Assessments) -> Officer Review Console (Screens C, D, E) -> Statutory Order (Approve/Reject) -> Immutable Event Ledger (audit_events)

college_workflow.login: Bcrypt-authenticated login via / route using institution email and secure password.
dashboard_cards: APPLY (Initialize new application or continue active draft)
APPLICATION STATUS (Track completeness, review stages, and final outcomes)
NOTIFICATIONS (Respond to statutory clarification inquiries with supplementary evidence)
college_workflow.document_upload: Selects document type from mandatory checklist (Land Title Certificate, Building Plan Approval, AICTE Affidavit 1, Fire Safety Certificate) and uploads PDF/image (max 15MB).
college_workflow.real_time_guidance: Shows instant plain-language guidance under each document (e.g. mismatch alert, scanned deed notice, duplicate warning) without exposing internal technical telemetry.
college_workflow.draft_management: Can download, delete, or replace documents while application is in DRAFT status.
college_workflow.final_submission: Submits dossier when completeness reaches 100%; application transitions to SUBMITTED and locks applicant modifications.

officer_workflow.login: Bcrypt-authenticated login via / route using official admin email.
dashboard_cards: APPLICATIONS (Active scrutiny queue with pending count)
ADD APPLICATION (Direct officer intake for manual registrations)
LOGS (Statutory immutable audit trail with event count)
officer_workflow.queue_management: Two-panel queue layout with sort by submission date/name/status, filter by status (SUBMITTED, UNDER_SCRUTINY, etc.), and keyword search.

individual_review.application_header: Application number, college name, permanent code, submission date, and institutional context remarks.
individual_review.summary_verdict_card: Compact Document Verification box showing X/Y uploaded, M/Y matched, result status (CLEAR vs ISSUE FOUND).
individual_review.actionable_findings: If issues exist, shows prominent cards displaying Expected, Uploaded, Finding, and Action.
individual_review.document_table: Compact list of uploaded documents with direct download buttons.
individual_review.technical_details_expander: Single collapsed section preserving all 24 granular checks, expected vs observed values, raw JSON evidence, and finding disposition forms.

statutory_decision.approve: 1-click approval with optional official remarks; updates status to APPROVED and logs audit event.
statutory_decision.reject: Rejection requires mandatory written statutory justification; updates status to REJECTED and logs audit event.
statutory_decision.clarify: Issues formal clarification inquiry with specific question and requested evidence; application transitions to CLARIFICATION_REQUESTED.

scenario_a.title: Scenario A: Incorrect Document Mismatch & Statutory Rejection
scenario_a.college_action: Apex Institute representative uploads Affiliation_Letter.pdf under the mandatory LAND_TITLE_CERTIFICATE category, alongside correct companion documents.
scenario_a.detection_mechanism: core/validation/checks/content_rules.py flags 'affiliation' as a discordant token for category LAND_TITLE_CERTIFICATE.
scenario_a.displayed_verdict: ISSUE FOUND (4/4 uploaded, 3/4 matched, 1 document needs attention).

displayed_finding.finding: The uploaded filename/category does not match the expected document.

scenario_a.officer_action: Scrutiny officer inspects finding, enters mandatory rejection justification: 'Application rejected due to statutory document mismatch: Affiliation Letter uploaded under Land Title requirement.', and clicks REJECT APPLICATION.
scenario_a.persisted_state: Application status updated to REJECTED; audit event APPLICATION_REJECTED permanently recorded.

scenario_b.title: Scenario B: Correct Statutory Dossier & 1-Click Approval
scenario_b.college_action: Apex Institute representative uploads 4 valid statutory documents: land_title_deed.pdf, building_plan_approval.pdf, aicte_affidavit_1.pdf, and fire_safety_certificate.pdf.
scenario_b.detection_mechanism: Validation engine verifies all 4 files contain concordant tokens, pass format/integrity checks, and pass keyword compliance.
scenario_b.displayed_verdict: CLEAR (4/4 uploaded, 4/4 matched, No document mismatches detected).
scenario_b.displayed_finding: 0 issues detected; displays confirmation that all automated checks passed.
scenario_b.officer_action: Scrutiny officer downloads and inspects documents, enters approval remarks: 'All statutory land, building, affidavit, and fire certificates verified and cleared.', and clicks APPROVE APPLICATION.
scenario_b.persisted_state: Application status updated to APPROVED; audit event APPLICATION_APPROVED permanently recorded.

test_files.coverage: Assessment aggregation, scanned image handling, active content detection, duplicate payload detection, conservative aggregation.
End-to-end execution of Scenario A (mismatch rejection) and Scenario B (clean approval).
Full regulatory lifecycle, multi-tenant isolation (Apex vs Beacon), unauthenticated route guards, persistence across restart, audit trail immutability.
1-verdict banner, 4-field actionable findings, incomplete check guards, cross-document discrepancy identification, applicant feedback.

Zero-byte file rejection, malformed PDF rejection, password protection detection, scanned PDF handling, SHA-256 duplicate detection, consumer tool detection, active script detection, officer dispositions.

demonstrated_limitations: No OCR engine is bundled in aegis-foundation; scanned image PDFs (<50 text characters) cannot be parsed for text keywords and are routed to human review.
Filename/category concordance does not establish physical authenticity; a correctly named PDF might contain fraudulent or altered contents.
Timestamp anomalies may reflect misconfigured scanning device clocks rather than malicious backdating.
The prototype uses synthetic demo PDF files rather than real institutional legal records.
The system is a reference architecture and is not connected to live AICTE or state government production databases.
potential_risks: Over-reliance on automated checks by fatigue-prone officers if clear disclaimers are not emphasized.
Regional variances in document naming across Indian states (e.g. Satbara 7/12 in Maharashtra, Patta in Tamil Nadu, Khasra in UP) require ongoing Rule Registry maintenance.
Scanned deeds with complex multi-page boundary sketches require high-resolution visual inspection tools.
defensible_presentation_claims: CLAIM: Aegis slashes cognitive fatigue by replacing 24 diagnostic parameters with a concise 1-verdict summary.
CLAIM: Aegis provides instant pre-submission compliance audit feedback to colleges, preventing avoidable administrative rejections.
CLAIM: Aegis operates 100% locally with zero cloud API token costs, ensuring complete institutional data privacy.
DO NOT CLAIM: Aegis detects 100% of forged documents with AI.
DO NOT CLAIM: Aegis is officially approved or deployed by AICTE.
DO NOT CLAIM: Aegis autonomously approves or rejects college applications.
